skillset.skill: 13s CT - 2300% Water DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 30. Additionally if used for the first time per Battle (Wave), increase own Arts by an additional 70.
skillset.arts: Increases all allies' Arts by 20. For 30s, redirect Allies' DMG taken to self, gain a DMG barrier that negates 25000 DMG to self & increase own MAG RES by 35%. Additionally, add 10000% to own Super Arts multiplier each time Arts is activated. (MAX 150000%)
skillset.truearts: 45000% Water DMG (PHY). For 30s, increase all allies' DMG against Fire/Light/Dark enemies by 200%.
skillset.superarts: 150000% Water DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 100. For 20s, reduce enemies' DMG RES by 100%.

passive.ability1: When this unit takes lethal DMG, prevent HP from dropping below 1 HP for 5s. Increase own Arts by 100. For 25s, increase own ATK by 100%. Ability can only be activated once per Quest.
passive.ability2: Increase own Paralysis & Freeze RES by 100%.
passive.ability3: When near-death, increase own Skill CT Speed by 20%.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Touma Kamijo's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Touma Kamijo's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.name: Touma's Uniform
trueweapon.skill: 40s CT - 6000% Water DMG (PHY). If own HP is 70% or above, for 10s, increase own PHY DMG by 50%. If own HP is below 70%, heal 30% of MAX HP instead.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Touma Kamijo, increase own DMG RES by 30% and Arts by 1/s. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
